title: Technical Archive Transfer Batch
summary: Temporary processing order for a routine batch of reviewed technical records moving into the institutional archive.

sections.title: ORDER CONTROL
sections.body:
**Order no.:** ARC-2603

**Issuing division:** Records Control

**Effective:** 2026-08-26 / records-processing shift

**Expiration:** Acceptance or return of every record in the current transfer batch

**Issuing authority:** Records Control Supervisor (role)

**Distribution:** Records Control and contributing technical units

sections.title: PURPOSE
sections.body:
**Operational requirement:** Reconcile one routine transfer batch before reviewed technical records enter the current institutional register.

**Reason:** Consolidated processing keeps identifiers, revisions, and controlling-office entries consistent.

**Desired end state:** Accepted records registered and exceptions returned to the contributing unit.

sections.title: DIRECTED ACTIONS
sections.body:
**Personnel affected:** Records Control staff and designated contributing-unit reviewers.

**Required action:** Confirm identifier, revision, status, controlling office, related records, and disclosure treatment before acceptance.

**Prohibited action:** Do not infer missing approvals or add unreviewed attachments.

**Record to maintain:** Archive transfer and exception log.

sections.title: AUTHORITY & TERMINATION
sections.body:
**Exceptions authorized by:** Records Control Supervisor (role).

**Automatic termination:** Acceptance or return of every record in the transfer batch.

**Extension requires:** Revised batch inventory and completion date.

**Order status:** Active.

sections.title: SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS / SHIFT NOTES
sections.body: Record metadata and record content are reviewed separately. A complete metadata line does not establish eligibility for a controlled body.

sections.title: ISSUER / RECEIVING SUPERVISOR ACKNOWLEDGMENT
sections.body: Records Control issued the transfer order. Contributing-unit review was acknowledged by role.
